title: B007: VSA Operations — Vector Symbolic Architecture with Noise Resilience v6.3
description: VSA operations: bind(a,b), unbind(bound,key), bundle2/3(a,b,c), cosineSimilarity, permute. Hyperdimensional vectors (1024D), {-1,0,+1} trits. Noise resilience: 0.75 accuracy at 50% noise. SIMD speedup: 10-17× (bind: 14×, bundle: 12×, cosine: 17×, permute: 14×). v6.3 adds VSA analysis notebook with noise resilience curves and SIMD benchmarks. ECE: 0.058-0.072, Brier Score: 0.162-0.185 (Excellent-Good calibration).
